messages.subject: Payout missing for trip TR-1042
messages.body: I completed TR-1042 on July 3rd evening (rider confirmed, 5 stars) but the fare never showed up in my earnings. My last three trips before it paid out fine. What's going on?

messages.subject: Re: Payout missing for trip TR-1042
messages.body: Day 4 now. Still nothing for TR-1042 and now TR-1054 is missing too. I drive full time — this is my rent money. Please escalate.

messages.subject: Payment stuck on 'processing' since Saturday
messages.body: My ride TR-1049 finished days ago but the app still shows 'payment processing' and I can't download a receipt. I need it for expense reporting by Friday.

messages.subject: Earnings dashboard shows $0 for the weekend
messages.body: Sunday's trips show $0 in my earnings tab even though riders confirmed them. App version 3.11.2. Other drivers in the lot say the same thing.

messages.subject: Left a blue umbrella in the car
messages.body: Left my umbrella in the back seat on yesterday's ride, Kia Niro. Could you connect me with the driver?

messages.subject: Cancelled ride still charged a fee?
messages.body: I cancelled TR-1057 within a minute of booking but I see a $2 cancellation fee hold on my card.

messages.subject: Re: Cancelled ride still charged a fee?
messages.body: Hi Cleo — that's a temporary authorization hold, not a charge. It drops off within 3 business days; no fee applies to cancellations under 2 minutes.
